cases.head: 8097a8b98a8691e85fb2441d4016b9b926320a52
rubric: Each calls row names one immediate caller and one callee; never merge snapshot and latestSessionID into one endpoint.

Before AgentStatus.swift invokes store.latestSessionID and an unqualified snapshot(query:). QueryObservation.swift is NOT supplied: retain that literal target or self.snapshot, not an invented direct call to UsageStore.snapshot.

Explain why reduced quota input preserves relevant decisions: all latest timestamp ties and reset-transition witnesses, with full coverage tracked separately. Ordered LIMIT 1 selections and 256/1024 batching are not an arbitrary overall row cap; do not claim constant total database work.
Migration registration and initialization are supplied in UsageStore.swift; acknowledge that wiring rather than declaring it missing. Distinguish unknown external writers and unobserved runs.
Describe only source-supported policy reuse, not complete semantic equivalence or benchmark speedups; performance documentation was omitted.
